summary: Enhance your skills with our ESG Reporting Training Course. Learn to navigate environmental, social, and governance standards for effective reporting.
lede: ESG reporting training helps professionals prepare, review, govern, or use sustainability disclosures with traceable supporting data. Participants practice assessing material impacts and risks, setting reporting boundaries, structuring emissions inventories, defining metrics, and linking disclosure claims to evidence using frameworks such as GRI Standards, IFRS S1 and S2, and the GHG Protocol. They also turn source records into controlled disclosure indexes, dashboards, and management reports.
audienceIntro: This ESG reporting training is designed for professionals who prepare, review, govern, assure, or use sustainability-related disclosures.
prerequisites: Experience level: This intermediate course extends into advanced operational application of ESG disclosure design, data controls, emissions workbooks, and reporting governance. Climate scenario analysis, nature assessment, and AI-assisted review are taught at a conceptual awareness or operational application level rather than technical engineering depth. Coding requirement: Coding is not required. You should be comfortable reviewing policies, working with spreadsheets, interpreting business metrics, and presenting findings to decision-makers. Equipment: Bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software and Power BI Desktop where permitted. Training datasets, templates, and worked reporting scenarios are provided.
